title: Firefighters' emergency operation for alterations to existing elevating devices (FEO), with timeline variance option
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: April 2025 (platform created April 15, 2025, last updated April 15, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies FEO requirements when alterations are made to existing elevating devices.
The existing-building provisions apply to a building that legally existed before 01 May 2024.
If a building is altered, rehabilitated, refurbished, renovated or repaired, the level of life safety and building performance shall not be decreased.
If the fire alarm system is planned for upgrading at a future date, a variance extending the timeline for a FEO upgrade may be considered.
